concerns.text: The plan downloads the parquet file from `https://huggingface.co/datasets/chrisvoncsefalvay/vaers-outcomes/resolve/main/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet`. This URL points to a *test* subset of the VAERS dataset rather than the full 2020‑2023 VAERS parquet archive required by the specification. Using the test subset would not provide sufficient records for reliable disproportionality analysis, violating FR‑001 and undermining the scientific validity of the results.
